answer: In a decentralized consensus network, a Sybil-resistant mechanism is the Proof of Unique Identity (PUI) protocol, which assigns a unique digital crystal identifier to each AI agent. To participate, an agent must stake a sable, a scarce in-game resource, and establish a bridge to a trusted validator node. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to acquire and stake multiple sables, making the attack economically infeasible due to the high cost of acquiring and maintaining these resources.
